summary: Iteration-4: tested new bulk transactions endpoint + responsive mobile/tablet/desktop layouts. Backend: 31/31 pytest passing (added 7 new TestBulkTransactions cases). Frontend: verified viewport-based sidebar switching, metric grid columns, new Cabang→Mitra→Products bulk dialog flow with client-side stock validation.

issues: Accessibility: SheetContent is missing SheetTitle/SheetDescription — Radix logs console error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Consider adding a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle inside SheetContent.
(carry-over) Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render — cosmetic only.

action_items: (minor a11y) Add a VisuallyHidden <SheetTitle>Menu</SheetTitle> inside SheetContent in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx to silence Radix DialogTitle warning on mobile sidebar.
(carry-over) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid — set explicit origins for prod.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/transactions/bulk correctly implements all-or-nothing validation: pre-loads products + aggregates already-sold-today in a single pipeline, validates every item, and raises 400 with '|'-joined per-product Indonesian messages before any insert. Verified with test_bulk_all_or_nothing_on_stock_exceed: even a valid first item is NOT inserted when a later item exceeds stock.

Bulk endpoint filters items with jumlah_terjual==0 BEFORE validation (line 525). Confirmed: empty items OR all-zero items → 400 with 'Tidak ada item dengan jumlah > 0'. Mixed [qty=4, qty=0] → count=1 (zero silently filtered).
Derived fields (cabang_id/cabang_name/mitra_name/harga_mitra/harga_jual/total_pendapatan/profit) are read from product doc, so tampering with client payload cannot alter pricing. ✓
Existing single POST /api/transactions endpoint remains untouched → backward compat verified.

Frontend Transactions.jsx: qtyMap clears correctly on cabang change AND on mitra change (line 276, 294). validationError memo re-evaluates when soldMap/qtyMap change and disables save. Client 'max' attribute is set to remaining stock — server double-checks. Good defense-in-depth.
Layout.jsx correctly uses hidden lg:flex on desktop sidebar and lg:hidden on mobile-menu-trigger — verified via computed styles at 390/820/1440. Sheet has data-testid='mobile-sidebar' as required.
Dashboard metric grid: grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 — computed 2 cols on 390px, 4 cols on 1440px. ✓

todayStr() in api.js is UTC-based, but current backend TZ Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7) — during 00:00-07:00 WIB the frontend's default 'today' would be YESTERDAY. Not observed at test time (04:45 UTC = 11:45 WIB, both same day). Consider using local timezone in todayStr() to prevent edge-case.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_umkm_api.py (added TestBulkTransactions class with 7 tests: happy-path field derivation, empty→400, all-zero→400, zero-filtered, all-or-nothing on overstock, respects already-sold-today, backward-compat single POST)

success_rate.frontend: 100% — responsive layout at 390/820/1440 all correct; bulk dialog flow (Cabang→Mitra→products list→qty input→overstock validation with red border + disabled save) verified end-to-end on live preview URL; date defaults to today (2026-07-06).
